{{#invoke:Ships|infobox}}<noinclude>
== Usage ==
Infobox for [[Ships|starship]] articles.

The template uses structured ship data stored at <code>Module:Data/Ships/&lt;Page name&gt;</code>:

<pre>{{Ship infobox}}</pre>

The current page title selects the structured record automatically. Article parameters may override structured defaults when necessary. Empty or unknown values are hidden.
